text.en:
Hold [Reload] to switch to Ruinscribe Turret Mode and make your next shot launch an autonomous floating turret. Costs 3 ammo.

Deploying a turret <title refills [G_refill] /> the magazine.

Turret lasts for 25 seconds and targets enemies in a 70 meter radius, firing a <pve 359 /> <pvp [131] /> damage missile at the closest target every 2 seconds.
